Railway Group D Result Court Case 2026: Finally Over!

The Railway Group D Result 2026 was delayed due to a court case filed by some Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA) candidates in the Telangana High Court. The petitioners raised concerns over the method used to award weightage marks in the final merit list and alleged that candidates who completed apprenticeship training after 2022 received an unfair advantage. Because of the ongoing legal proceedings, candidates were eagerly waiting for clarity on the recruitment process. However, the court has now allowed the Railways to continue the recruitment process and declare the RRB Group D Result 2026.

The long-awaited court case related to the RRB Group D Result has finally seen a major development. The Telangana High Court has allowed the Railway Recruitment Boards to continue the recruitment process and declare the result. Following are the Judgements related to Railway Group D Court Case.

  • The High Court has permitted the Railways to proceed with the recruitment process under CEN 08/2024. This means there is no restriction on the declaration of the RRB Group D Result and further selection stages.
  • The Railway Recruitment Board has opened the application modification window for RRB Group D CCAA candidates under CEN No 08/2024 from 17th June to 23rd June 2026, allowing applicants to update their application details, including NCVT certificate information and marks.
  • The petitioners had requested the court to prepare the final merit list only on the basis of CBT scores and remove the one-third weightage given to CCAA candidates. However, the court did not accept this demand and refused to change the recruitment criteria.
  • The court stated that changing the merit calculation method after the recruitment process has started would amount to rewriting the recruitment rules. Therefore, the current formula of CBT marks and NCVT weightage will remain unchanged.
  • While rejecting the major relief sought by the petitioners, the court observed that the concerns regarding transparency and uniformity in awarding weightage marks cannot be completely ignored.
  • The Directorate General of Training (DGT) has been directed to examine the representations submitted by the petitioners regarding the 2022 policy changes and the method used for awarding weightage marks to CCAA candidates.
  • The court instructed the Railway authorities to conduct proper scrutiny and eligibility verification of all candidates applying under the CCAA quota during the document verification stage.
  • Only 15 Vacancies Kept Reserved – As a precautionary measure, the court directed the Railways to reserve 15 vacancies until the final disposal of the main writ petition. The remaining vacancies can be filled as per the recruitment process.

Steps to Check the RRB Group D Result 2026 at rrbcdg.gov.in

Step 1: Visit the official website of the Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) or the respective regional RRB website.

Step 2: Locate the link for “RRB Group D CEN 08/2024 Level 1 Result” on the homepage.

Step 3: Click on the relevant result link provided.

Step 4: Download the result PDF file displayed on the screen.

Step 5: Search for their registration number in the PDF using the Ctrl + F.

Step 6: Check the scorecard by logging in with their registration number and date of birth.

Step 7: Download or print the result for future reference.

The RRB Group D 2025-26 Exam was overall easy to moderate with numerous difficult shifts. Mathematics was lengthy, Reasoning was scoring, General Science was concept-based, and General Awareness was moderate but unpredictable. A good attempt ranged between 70–82 questions.

What After RRB Group D Result 2026?

After the RRB Group D Result 2026 is declared, candidates who qualify in the Computer Based Test (CBT) are shortlisted for the next stage, which is the Physical Efficiency Test (PET). This stage is qualifying in nature, meaning candidates only need to pass it and the marks are not added to the final merit. Those who successfully clear the PET are then called for Document Verification, where they must present all required certificates such as educational qualifications, identity proof, and category certificates if applicable. The RRB Group D Physical Test 2026 will be conducted in August 2026 in offline mode.

Railway Group D PET 2026 Date

All the candidates who will pass in the 1st stage (Computer Based Test), will appear in the next stage that is Physical Efficiency Test (PET). It is expected that the RRB Group D PET 2026 Exam will held in August 2026. The Railway has already uploaded on the requirements for the PET Exam.

In conclusion, the RRB Group D result 2026 has brought clarity to candidates about their exam performance. Qualified candidates should now prepare for the Physical Efficiency Test (PET). Candidates should keep all the required documents ready for PET and verification. For better preparation, candidates can use the Testbook app. This app offers mock tests and previous papers and many other study materials.

Student’s Queries on Railway RRB Group D Result 2026

Q1. When will the RRB Group D Result 2026 be released?
Ans: The RRB Group D Result 2026 is expected to be released in the 4th week of June 2026 at the official website.

Q2. Why was the RRB Group D Result 2026 delayed?
Ans. The result was delayed due to a court case in the Telangana High Court related to the weightage marks given to CCAA candidates in the recruitment process.

Q3. Has the court allowed RRB to declare the Group D Result 2026?
Ans. Yes, the High Court has allowed the Railway Recruitment Boards to continue the recruitment process and declare the RRB Group D Result 2026.

Q4. Did the court stop the Group D recruitment process?
Ans. No, the court did not stop the recruitment process. It only directed the authorities to reserve 15 vacancies while allowing the remaining recruitment process to continue.

Q5. When will the RRB Group D Scorecard 2026 be released?
Ans: The RRB Group D Scorecard is expected to be released along with or shortly after the result in June 2026, and candidates can download it by logging in with their credentials.

Q6. What is the pass mark for Railway Group D?
Ans. The minimum qualifying marks for Railway Recruitment Board Group D are 40% for general category, 30% for OBC/SC category, and 25% for ST category.

Q7. For How many vacancies will the Group D Level 1 Result announced?
Ans: The Railway Group D Result will be announced for about 32,438 vacancies (where 15 posts are kept reserved).
